caption_used: The character distribution in RoleplayPref is organized into three primary categories — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters — with 13 subcategories in the outer ring. Virtual Characters occupy approximately 60% of the distribution and are subdivided into Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Movie Characters forming the largest virtual subcategory. Real Characters comprise seven subcategories including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians representing the largest real-character segment. Custom Characters occupy a small portion with no labeled subcategories.

raw_responses.English:
The chart is a nested pie chart that represents the distribution of characters in RoleplayPref across three primary categories and their respective subcategories. The chart is divided into 3 main slices and 13 subcategories in the outer ring. The largest slice, "Virtual Characters," is light blue and occupies approximately 60% of the chart, and is further divided into 5 subcategories: Comic Characters (largest, light blue), Movie Characters (dark blue), Teleplay Characters (blue), Novel Characters (light blue), and Game Characters (light blue). The "Real Characters" slice is green and comprises about 30% of the chart, with 7 subcategories: Scientists (dark green), Artists (green), Athletes (green), Writers (light green), Musicians (light green), Actors (light green), and Influencers (lightest green), with Musicians being the largest real-character segment. The smallest slice, "Custom Characters," is pink and has no labeled subcategories. The chart does not include a legend, but labels are provided for each slice and subcategory. The segments are ordered by category and subcategory, with the larger categories divided into smaller subcategories in the outer ring.
